message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need | How it works | |---------|---------------|--------------| | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue). Each color has numbers 0‑9 (two of each 1‑9, one 0) and two of each action card: Skip, Reverse, Draw Two. Plus 4 Wild cards and 4 Wild Draw Four cards. | Shuffle the deck and deal 7 cards to each player. Place the remaining cards face‑down to form the draw pile. Turn the top card face‑up to start the discard pile. | | **Goal** | Be the first player to score **500 points** (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are tallied after each round. | | **Gameplay** | 1. Play proceeds clockwise (unless a Reverse changes direction). 2. On your turn, you may play **one** card that matches either the **color**, the **number**, or the **action** of the top discard. 3. If you have no playable card, you must **draw** one from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no other playable card; otherwise, the opponent can challenge.) | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you play your **second‑to‑last** card, you must shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards all their cards. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of the cards left in opponents’ hands: numbers = face value, action cards = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Scoring & Next Round** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. If the winner reaches or exceeds the target (e.g., 500), the game ends. Otherwise, shuffle the discard pile (except the top card) to form a new draw pile and start a new round with the same dealer order. | | **Optional Variations** | • **Stacking** – allow Draw Two / Wild Draw Four to stack (next player draws cumulative cards).
• **Seven‑Eight** – play a 7 to swap hands, an 8 to reverse direction.
• **Custom Rules** – many house‑rules exist; just agree before play. | --- ### Quick Play‑through Example 1. **Setup**: 4 players. Each gets 7 cards. Top of discard pile: Red 5. 2. **Player A** (clockwise) has a Red 9 → plays it. 3. **Player B** has a Yellow 9 → plays it. 4. **Player C** has a Yellow Skip → plays it. Player D loses a turn. 5. **Player D** draws a card (Yellow 2) → plays it. 6. **Player A** has no matching card → draws one (Blue 4). Cannot play → turn ends. 7. Continue until someone discards all cards. --- ### Tips for New Players - **Keep track of colors**: If you’re low on a particular color, try to play it early to avoid being stuck later. - **Use Wilds strategically**: Save them for when you’re about to run out of playable cards. - **Watch the discard pile**: If someone plays a Wild Draw Four, you can challenge if you suspect they had a playable card. - **Remember UNO**: It’s easy to forget, but the penalty is worth avoiding. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
